reuse.why: Adds the flag to the existing shared shouldWriteMonthBudget predicate in month-action.ts and passes it from every month-wide action.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is changed in one place; the only repetition is the optional parameter threaded through six action signatures, which the existing per-action structure requires.

placement.why: The rule change sits in the dedicated month-action module and the actions only forward their argument.

scope.why: Touches only the predicate, the six month-wide actions and the predicate's unit tests.

maintainability.why: A defaulted boolean on the single exclusion predicate keeps all exclusions together and is easy to follow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) call shouldWriteMonthBudget with the flag.
